geometry.note: Current FCStd is source-locked, but exact roof-surface semantic extraction remains open. No roof area or curvature radius is invented here.

source_basis: SRC-INT-001 Solar Hull.pdf via Solar Hull v0.2 source register

candidate_stack.function: Optical/environmental protection and possible optical tuning
candidate_stack.watchtower_delta: Must demonstrate terrestrial UV, rain, humidity, abrasion, cleaning, hail/impact exposure where applicable, drainage compatibility and curved-roof adhesion.

candidate_stack.material_or_candidate: Photoactive absorber chemistry TBD + copper routing/collector
candidate_stack.watchtower_delta: Select photoactive chemistry; measure terrestrial I-V, spectral response, temperature coefficient, shading/curvature effects and electrical isolation.

candidate_stack.material_or_candidate: Bismuth, Bi2Te3-family or comparative thermal/TE candidate
candidate_stack.function: Heat spreading / thermal-gradient sensing or recovery candidate
candidate_stack.watchtower_delta: Elemental Bi and Bi-family compounds must not be conflated; thermal and Seebeck response require measured terrestrial coupon evidence.

candidate_stack.function: Conductive backbone, grounding/discharge path, reinforcement and EMI support
candidate_stack.watchtower_delta: Material selection must account for CTE, corrosion, galvanic interfaces, fire/electrical path, roof curvature and substrate compatibility.

candidate_stack.material_or_candidate: Conductive primer / electroless Cu-Ni seed / Ti adhesion layer or comparative route
candidate_stack.function: Enable metallisation and control interface continuity/stress
candidate_stack.watchtower_delta: Surface preparation and adhesion route must be validated on the selected Watch Tower roof substrate.

candidate_stack.material_or_candidate: Graphene-polymer / polymer / ceramic-compatible or other engineered roof substrate
candidate_stack.function: Roof carrier geometry and mechanical backing
candidate_stack.watchtower_delta: Solar Hull v0.2 coupon substrate thicknesses are not inherited as Watch Tower roof structural thicknesses. Structural substrate is separately engineered.

qualification_sequence.name: Source and geometry lock
qualification_sequence.exit: FCStd SHA and Solar Hull source revision recorded; roof surfaces remain explicit semantic objects once extracted.

qualification_sequence.name: Flat material coupon
qualification_sequence.exit: Layer thickness, adhesion, continuity, electrical and optical baseline logged with raw evidence.

qualification_sequence.name: Curved coupon
qualification_sequence.exit: Curvature-induced cracking/delamination, optical/electrical loss and thermal response measured.

qualification_sequence.name: Terrestrial environment
qualification_sequence.exit: UV, humidity, water, corrosion, abrasion/cleaning and temperature cycling evidence recorded.

qualification_sequence.name: Roof safety/interface
qualification_sequence.exit: Drainage/ponding, electrical/grounding, fire/combustibility, waterproofing and substrate-interface review completed.

qualification_sequence.name: Representative roof assembly
qualification_sequence.exit: Representative curved-roof assembly tested under reviewed structural/environmental/electrical conditions.

qualification_sequence.name: Independent review / application decision
qualification_sequence.exit: Application-specific engineering review establishes allowed claim/design state.

test_families: surface preparation and conductive seed continuity
optical transmission / haze / reflectance / UV ageing
thermal conductivity / gradient / Seebeck candidate response
